plan.title: feat(session): show a throttled newer-release advisory at mutable session start

narratives.Description: Add a bounded npm release-availability probe to mutable session:start. The probe is separate from doctor so bare doctor and the gated ritual doctor remain offline by default (#2182). It discloses registry access, skips DEFT_NO_NETWORK=1, framework repositories, non-release refs, and read-only session starts, and persists a 24-hour once-per-version notification throttle.
narratives.Scope: Session-start wiring, release-availability probe and state, focused tests, consumer guidance, and generated AGENTS entry. Excludes #2488 interactive tickler UI and #2489 escalation.

items.title: Mutable session:start emits a disclosed, non-fatal advisory when a newer published release is available.
The advisory respects a 24-hour once-per-latest-version throttle and DEFT_NO_NETWORK=1.
Bare doctor and gated ritual doctor remain offline by default.
Docs and generated agents entry describe the operator signal.
